checks.label: Subtracting a vector is the same as adding a negative version of it, the same arrow with its direction reversed: on the grid the answer is the first arrow plus the second turned round, every part of the turned-round arrow has its sign flipped, and adding the second arrow back onto the answer lands on the first arrow's nose

Displacement is found by subtracting the initial position from the final position: the move from buoy A to buoy B is B's position minus A's wherever B is dragged, its readout takes A's parts from B's, and the move from P to Q is q − p

The velocity of one vessel relative to another is the vector difference of their velocities, both measured over the ground: seen from the boat, everything gets your velocity turned round added, so your boat stays still, the bank moves at minus your velocity and the other vessel at its velocity minus yours

Over the ground the boat moves along its heading plus the stream: at every heading, speed and stream it can be set to, the ground arrow is their sum, and the track lands opposite the start only when the upstream part cancels the stream

Every number follows from the rule: 5 − 1 = 4 and 2 − 3 = −1, or 6i + 5j added; 3 − 2 = 1 and 4 − (−1) = 5; 6 − 1 = 5 and 5 − 2 = 3; −2 − 4 = −6 and 3 − (−1) = 4; BC = 2 × AB and BD = 3 × AB; √(4² + 3²) = 5 m/s at 36.87° off the heading; aimed off, √(4² − 3²) = 2.65 m/s at 48.59°; √(5² − 3²) = 4 and √(5² + 3²) = 5.83; √(6² + 8²) = 10 knots; 12 − (−12) = 24 knots; 40 ÷ 4 = 10 s, 3 × 10 = 30 m and √(40² + 30²) = 50 m
C lies on the line through A and B exactly when BC is a whole multiple of AB: for every point C can be dragged to, copies of AB fill BC and the readout names the multiple only then
Every puzzle offers three different answers with exactly one accepted, gives each wrong one its own hint, and draws a wrong pick in red but a right one without
Before Check no puzzle's picture shows its answer, and a right answer shows it
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion within 2.5 s
